title: Serre criterion for affineness
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs global functions from the H1 vanishing hypothesis and obtains affine principal neighbourhoods. It then combines a finite principal-open cover with a unit-ideal argument to prove affineness; the covering construction is part of the problem rather than an assumed affineness criterion.
